method: replies matched to requests by the page-71 sequence byte (counts control pages 48-51 and page-70 requests, mod 256); repeats of an answered reply are copies; a request is lost when no reply carries its sequence

stale_echoes.method: echo of a control value after a different value of the same page was written; age from the first write of the superseding value (add the writer delay, at most 0.75 s, for age from the desired change)
